pages.text: $(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)The Formation Plane places blocks and drops items. It works similarly to an insert-only $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_bus)ME Storage Bus$(/l), placing/dropping when things are "stored" in it by $(l:ae2_mechanics/devices)devices$(/l) inserting into $(l:ae2_mechanics/import_export_storage)network storage$(/l), like $(l:items_blocks_machines/import_bus)ME Import Bus$(/l)ses and $(l:items_blocks_machines/interface)ME Interface$(/l)s.$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this$()

$(#555)$(o)version)$()$(br2)Notice that these are similar to the import bus -> storage bus and interface -> storage bus pipes in $(l:example_setups/pipe_subnet)pipe subnets$(/l).$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)$(#555)$(o)(3D scene not available in this version)$()$(br2)This $(l:ae2_mechanics/devices)device$(/l) makes use of the mechanics used by storage busses in things like $(l:example_setups/pipe_subnet)pipe$(/l)

$(l:example_setups/pipe_subnet)subnets$(/l), and can replace storage busses in those setups if you want to drop items/place blocks instead of transport items.$(br2)They are $(l:ae2_mechanics/cable_subparts)cable subparts$(/l).$(br2)$(bold)REMEMBER TO ENABLE FAKE PLAYERS IN YOUR CHUNK CLAIM$()

pages.title: Filtering
pages.text: By default the plane will place/drop anything. Items inserted into its filter slots will act as a whitelist, only allowing those specific items to be placed.$(br2)Items and fluids can be dragged into the slots from JEI/REI even if you don't actually have any of that item.$(br2)Right-click with a fluid container (like a bucket or fluid tank) to set that fluid as
a filter instead of the bucket or tank item.

pages.title: Priority
pages.text: Priorities can be set by clicking the wrench in the top-right of the GUI. Items entering the network will start at the highest priority storage.

pages.title: Settings
pages.text: $(li)The plane can be set to place blocks in-world or drop items

pages.title: Upgrades
pages.text: The formation plane supports the following $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)upgrades$(/l):$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Capacity Card$(/l) increases the amount of filter slots$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Fuzzy Card$(/l) lets the plane filter by damage level and/or ignore item NBT$(li)$(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)Inverter Card$(/l) switches the filter from a whitelist to a blacklist
